propositions: Managed links marked locally lack persistent evidence of peer confirmation, preventing distinction between never-pushed local links and peer-deleted ones in the inbound removal path.
New peer confirmation store must record full confirmation details (link_id, direction, pass_id, confirmed_at, source) and survive ticket-log snapshot compactions without loss.
Confirmation recording must be triggered at the outbound ADD success point in dispatch without gaining knowledge of store binding or pass context, using a callback-based injection pattern.
Unbound targets (keys missing from binding store reverse map) must skip recording entirely and not persist vendor keys in local-id fields.
Confirmation-only changes must be committed to the repository by staging in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames; staging in _rel_files alone is insufficient due to per-file idempotency guards.
Failed set_relationship calls or raised confirmation callbacks must not fail the outbound link operation or perturb computed/applied/failed counts; failures must be logged and swallowed.
